backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin usage and two public types for render rules and Genesis craft preview metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing summarized descriptions of various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing routing, project state, persistence, and lazy‑loaded feature pages.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable alert dialog for confirming destructive actions using a global confirmation store.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project with fields for name, symbol, size, and pixel art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Glossy: Animated glossy hero text reacting to pointer movement using a reflection overlay.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Tile button that triggers creation of a new project with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog allowing users to edit project settings such as name, symbol, size, and pixel art mode.
Renders a clickable project tile with blockchain tag, metadata, and settings/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with attribution and heart icon styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header rendering project navigation, mobile menu, and save status indicator.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Hover/focus tooltip component with fade‑in animation and positioned popover.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports lightweight inline SVG icon components used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Animated icon‑button component with scaling and focus‑ring behaviors.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog explaining how to obtain a Pinata JWT token, including warnings and step-by-step instructions.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a compact save status label that updates based on saving state.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Controls locking, unlocking, and uploading an NFT collection to IPFS with status handling and confirmations.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle buttons to switch between compact and grid view modes in the vault UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand-powered confirmation modal flow returning a promise for destructive actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, loading, login, and identity management via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Validates a Pinata JWT with debouncing and cancellation, exposing validation status and message.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file since persistence uses localStorage instead of backend queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, color variables, motion settings, and UI utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, QueryClient, and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Handles trait selection, image compositing on canvas, file uploads, and manual token creation for a project.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays all projects, supports creating, selecting, editing, and deleting projects via dialogs and tiles.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Renders merged layer previews, validates rule‑compatible trait combinations, and provides trait shuffling.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Manages per-layer trait rarity weights with normalization, locking, and automatic initialization.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Allows adding, editing, duplicating, and deleting trait compatibility rules within a project.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: React settings page that manages project configuration, Pinata key validation, metadata format selection, and Solana creator handling with live validation.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Vault page for NFT generation using a web worker, handling progress, filtering, view modes, and updating the project with generated NFTs.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Workshop page for managing layers and traits, including adding, deleting, renaming, reordering, and updating related project rules.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Utility for uploading NFT images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata with progress tracking and structured upload result handling.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Functions that build metadata previews and final metadata for NFTs, supporting multiple blockchain formats and IPFS image paths.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: LocalStorage persistence utilities providing atomic saves, canonical snapshot loading, legacy cleanup, size estimation, and quota checks.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides helpers to validate Pinata JWT tokens and upload files or JSON to IPFS, returning structured success/error details.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines TypeScript interfaces and message types for communication between the NFT generator worker and the UI.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Implements an async utility that yields to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during heavy operations.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web worker that performs NFT generation logic including trait selection, rule validation, DNA creation, and optional image compositing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, spacing, fonts, animations, and enabling dark mode with custom design tokens.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, features, issues, and architectural notes for the NFT generator system.
